system.description:
You can extract the final biological,
neural, or cybernetic record from a
corpse, damaged implant, memory
chip, or dead biomonitor.
Make an Interface Roll (13).
On a success with Hope, you find the
answer to three questions. On a
success with Fear, you find the answer
to one question.
The information is reliable, but you
cannot discover anything beyond what
the target knew or witnessed in life.
On a failure, or after you find your
answers, the body, implant, or data
source becomes unusable for this
protocol.
